title: Synthetic Local Capacity Benchmark Configuration
description: Input configuration for the deterministic synthetic_local capacity benchmark CLI (DEP-01 foundation). Contains harness inputs only: concurrency, duration, warmup, headroom placeholder, and a cost-unit definition. Contains no real endpoints, no credentials, no provider prices, and no capacity conclusions. Provider pricing and entitlements remain PENDING owner verification.

scenario.description: The only supported scenario. The harness runs a local, deterministic simulation; live targets are owner-operated and never run in CI.

concurrency.description: Target concurrent session count to simulate. An input to the synthetic harness, not a measured capacity claim.

durationSeconds.description: Measurement window length after warmup, in seconds.

warmupSeconds.description: Synthetic warmup window, in seconds. Warmup observations are not included in reported results.

headroomPercent.description: SRE-input placeholder for the safety headroom percentage to apply. Stored as an input only; the synthetic harness derives no capacity conclusion from it.

saturationThresholdPercent.description: Synthetic saturation detection threshold expressed as worker utilization percent. A harness parameter, not a pass/fail budget.

label.description: Unit label, for example 'per concurrent session-hour'. A definition only, never a price.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the future cost unit.

pricingStatus.description: Provider pricing and entitlement verification is PENDING owner verification. No price value is stored here.
